C-0001.text: Hypnosis is accompanied by measurable, replicable brain-activity/connectivity changes (DMN/SN/ECN, theta, parieto-occipital, frontoparietal) — a necessary condition for an altered-state claim.
C-0001.verifier_notes: See EV-0027. Reinforced in cycle 2 by causal TMS evidence (EV-0029/0030/0031) which goes beyond correlation.

C-0002.text: No hypnosis-specific unique physiological fingerprint exists; induction effects are small and expectancy/hypnotizability often matter more — supports non-state/sociocognitive interpretation.
C-0002.verifier_notes: See EV-0027. Note: cycle-2 causal evidence (C-0007) complicates the strong sociocognitive reading — TMS effects beyond expectancy (EV-0030) show frontal mechanisms are causally involved — but does not refute 'no unique fingerprint'.

C-0003.text: The field itself reports NO consensus on hypnosis mechanisms; the ALE meta-analysis failed to confirm predicted DMN/SN/CEN involvement — brain-correlate story is heterogeneous and contested.

C-0004.text: Emerging 2022-2025 synthesis dissolves the state/non-state dichotomy: predictive coding/active inference unifies 'state-like' precision-weighting and 'non-state-like' priors/expectancy.
C-0004.verifier_notes: VERIFIED-BUT-SCOPED. Reinforced by Wagstaff 2026 (EV-0034) explicitly arguing no necessary contradiction between altered-state and ordinary-process accounts.

C-0005.text: The strict 'trance required' (qualitative state) hypothesis is largely ruled out, but the broader altered-state question remains open and is best framed as a continuum, not a dichotomy.
C-0005.verifier_notes: See EV-0027. Reinforced by EV-0034 (Wagstaff continuum framing) and EV-0035 (clinical decoupling).

C-0006.text: Genuinely unresolved: (a) causal vs epiphenomenal brain changes; (b) trait vs state hypnotizability; (c) which mechanistic theory (cold control vs dissociated control vs SATH vs ability-based) is correct.
C-0006.verifier_notes: See EV-0027. Cycle 2 PARTIALLY addresses axis (a): TMS shows frontal mechanisms are causally involved (not purely epiphenomenal), but does not resolve axes (b) or (c). C-0007 sharpens (c): cold-control and dissociated-control make the same prediction for the DLPFC manipulation.

C-0007.text: Causal-intervention evidence (TMS/tDCS) is the most decisive test available but does NOT cleanly separate cold-control from dissociated-control — both predict DLPFC-inhibition increases hypnotizability, which is what is observed. The causal evidence supports a state-leaning (frontal-mechanism) account but cannot adjudicate the specific theory.
C-0007.verifier_notes: EV-0029 (Faerman SHIFT RCT, p=0.046), EV-0030 (Dienes&Hutton, expectancy controlled), EV-0031 (ISH review converging) all support DLPFC-inhibition→increased hypnotizability. EV-0015 documents both theories predict same direction. Logic holds. Note the ISH review (EV-0031) caveats: small samples, subjective measures, limited neurophysiological confirmation. Confirmed beyond-expectancy effect (EV-0030) is the key anti-pure-sociocognitive point.

C-0008.text: The state/non-state distinction has NO demonstrated bearing on clinical efficacy — hypnosis works regardless of which theory is true; the practical moderator is HYPNOTIZABILITY, not theoretical allegiance. This dissolves much of the practical urgency of the debate.
C-0008.verifier_notes: EV-0033 (49 meta-analyses, 99.2% positive, hypnotizability only consistent moderator r=0.24). EV-0034 (Wagstaff false-dichotomy). The decoupling of clinical efficacy from theoretical model is directly supported. Caveat: hypnotizability itself is the contested construct, so 'decoupled' is practical not philosophical.

verifier_conflicts.resolution: resolvable — dispute is over specificity/uniqueness, not existence of change

hermeneutic/provenance conflict; cycle-2 causal evidence (C-0007) partially adjudicates by showing frontal mechanisms are causally involved beyond expectancy, weakening pure-epiphenomenal reading but not settling specific theory
paradigm/sample/protocol heterogeneity, not hard contradiction; reinforces C-0003
